```go
package alphametics

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

// Solve solves an alphametics puzzle of the form
//
//	"WORD + WORD + ... == WORD"
//
// and returns a mapping from each letter to a distinct digit such that the
// equation holds. Each letter maps to a different digit, and the leading
// letter of a multi-letter word may not map to zero. An error is returned
// if the puzzle has no solution or is malformed.
func Solve(puzzle string) (map[string]int, error) {
	sides := strings.Split(puzzle, "==")
	if len(sides) != 2 {
		return nil, errors.New(`invalid puzzle: expected exactly one "=="`)
	}

	coeff := map[rune]int64{}
	leading := map[rune]bool{}

	addTerms := strings.Split(sides[0], "+")
	resTerms := strings.Split(sides[1], "+")
	all := make([]string, 0, len(addTerms)+len(resTerms))
	all = append(all, addTerms...)
	all = append(all, resTerms...)

	for i, term := range all {
		word := strings.TrimSpace(term)
		if word == "" {
			return nil, errors.New("invalid puzzle: empty term")
		}
		for _, ch := range word {
			if ch < 'A' || ch > 'Z' {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid puzzle: %q is not a letter", string(ch))
			}
		}
		if len(word) > 1 {
			leading[word[0]] = true
		}
		sign := int64(1)
		if i >= len(addTerms) {
			sign = -1
		}
		place := int64(1)
		for j := len(word) - 1; j >= 0; j-- {
			coeff[word[j]] += sign * place
			place *= 10
		}
	}

	if len(coeff) > 10 {
		return nil, errors.New("puzzle has more than ten letters")
	}

	// Order the letters so that the most constraining ones are assigned first.
	type letter struct {
		ch   rune
		coef int64
	}
	ls := make([]letter, 0, len(coeff))
	for ch, c := range coeff {
		ls = append(ls, letter{ch, c})
	}
	sort.Slice(ls, func(i, j int) bool {
		ai, aj := abs64(ls[i].coef), abs64(ls[j].coef)
		if ai != aj {
			return ai > aj
		}
		return ls[i].ch < ls[j].ch
	})

	s := &solver{
		letters:  make([]rune, len(ls)),
		coefs:    make([]int64, len(ls)),
		leading:  make([]bool, len(ls)),
		assign:   make([]int, len(ls)),
		solution: make([]int, len(ls)),
	}
	for i, l := range ls {
		s.letters[i] = l.ch
		s.coefs[i] = l.coef
		s.leading[i] = leading[l.ch]
		s.assign[i] = -1
	}

	if !s.search(0) {
		return nil, errors.New("puzzle has no solution")
	}

	out := make(map[string]int, len(ls))
	for i, d := range s.solution {
		out[string(s.letters[i])] = d
	}
	return out, nil
}

type solver struct {
	letters  []rune
	coefs    []int64
	leading  []bool
	assign   []int
	solution []int
	used     [10]bool
	partial  int64
}

func (s *solver) search(i int) bool {
	if i == len(s.letters) {
		return s.partial == 0
	}
	if !s.feasible(i) {
		return false
	}
	for d := 0; d <= 9; d++ {
		if s.used[d] || (s.leading[i] && d == 0) {
			continue
		}
		s.assign[i] = d
		s.used[d] = true
		s.partial += s.coefs[i] * int64(d)
		if s.search(i + 1) {
			s.solution[i] = d
			return true
		}
		s.partial -= s.coefs[i] * int64(d)
		s.used[d] = false
		s.assign[i] = -1
	}
	return false
}

// feasible reports whether the unassigned letters i..n can still make the
// linear equation balance, given the digits that are still available.
func (s *solver) feasible(i int) bool {
	target := -s.partial
	n := len(s.letters) - i
	if n == 0 {
		return target == 0
	}
	coefs := make([]int64, n)
	for j := i; j < len(s.letters); j++ {
		coefs[j-i] = s.coefs[j]
	}
	digits := make([]int, 0, 10-i)
	for d := 0; d <= 9; d++ {
		if !s.used[d] {
			digits = append(digits, d)
		}
	}
	if len(digits) < n {
		return false
	}
	sort.Slice(coefs, func(a, b int) bool { return coefs[a] < coefs[b] })
	sort.Ints(digits)
	min, max := int64(0), int64(0)
	for k := 0; k < n; k++ {
		// Pair the smallest coefficient with the largest digit (and vice
		// versa) to reach the extreme values of the remaining sum.
		min += coefs[k] * int64(digits[len(digits)-1-k])
		max += coefs[k] * int64(digits[k])
	}
	return target >= min && target <= max
}

func abs64(v int64) int64 {
	if v < 0 {
		return -v
	}
	return v
}
```

minSum/maxSum via DP:

```go
// maxSum computes the maximum of Σ coefs[i]·d over injective assignments of
// the sorted coefficients to a subset of the sorted digits.
func maxSum(coefs, digits []int64) int64 {
	n, m := len(coefs), len(digits)
	// dp[j] = best value when the smallest i coefficients are matched to a
	// subsequence of the first j digits.
	const negInf = -1 << 62
	prev := make([]int64, m+1)
	for j := range prev {
		prev[j] = negInf
	}
	prev[0] = 0
	for i := 1; i <= n; i++ {
		cur := make([]int64, m+1)
		for j := range cur {
			cur[j] = negInf
		}
		for j := i; j <= m; j++ {
			// Skip digit j, or match coefficient i with digit j.
			best := prev[j]
			if v := prev[j-1] + coefs[i-1]*digits[j-1]; v > best {
				best = v
			}
			cur[j] = best
		}
		prev = cur
	}
	return prev[m]
}
```
